name: s252-hatch-circle
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, ladders: 6, bridges: 6, figX: -250, figY: 60, things: [] }); let i = 0; for (let h = 1; h <= 6 && !i; h++) if (houseLinks(B, h - 1).some(L => L.way === "down" && L.to >= 0)) i = h; B["hatchShape" + i] = "circle"; B.inside = i; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700));

name: s252-hatch-triangle
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, ladders: 6, bridges: 6, figX: -250, figY: 60, things: [] }); let i = 0; for (let h = 1; h <= 6 && !i; h++) if (houseLinks(B, h - 1).some(L => L.way === "down" && L.to >= 0)) i = h; B["hatchShape" + i] = "triangle"; B.inside = i; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700));

name: s252-ceiling-triangle
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, ladders: 6, bridges: 6, figX: -250, figY: 60, things: [] }); let i = 0; for (let h = 1; h <= 6 && !i; h++) if (houseLinks(B, h - 1).some(L => L.way === "down" && L.to >= 0)) i = h; B["hatchShape" + i] = "triangle"; B.inside = houseLinks(B, i - 1).find(L => L.way === "down").to + 1; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700));

name: s252-trap-square-triangle
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; Object.assign(state.access, DEFAULTS.access, { showSolids: true }); Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "castleroom", castle: "N", castleRoom: 3, figX: 0, figY: 20, things: [], castlePitShape1N: "square", castlePitShape2N: "triangle" }); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700));
